The {{tt|Leader|Totem}} of Brooklet Hill!'') is the ninth chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== {{spoilers}} * {{adv|Sun}} is tasked by [[Lana]] to defeat the [[Totem Pokémon]] of [[Brooklet Hill]]. * Sun and Lana head off to Brooklet Hill, [[Kiawe]] goes to work, while {{adv|Moon}} and [[Mallow]] go to [[Lush Jungle]] to collect [[Berry]] samples. * At the [[Heahea City|Dimensional Research Lab]], [[Professor Kukui]] learns from [[Professor Burnet]] that [[Nebby]] is a [[Legendary Pokémon]] named {{p|Cosmog}}. * At Brooklet Hill, Sun befriends a wild {{p|Wishiwashi}}, which he [[nickname]]s Quarter and asks to help search for the Totem Pokémon. * After {{adv|Dollar}} scares Quarter out of anger, it summons other Wishiwashi to form a {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Wishiwashi|School Form}} Wishiwashi, the Totem of Brooklet Hill. * At Lush Jungle, Moon and Mallow witness {{p|Tapu Lele}} in battle with a {{p|Xurkitree}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Wishiwashi}} ({{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Wishiwashi|Solo and School Forms}}) * {{p|Tapu Lele}} * {{p|Xurkitree}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Sun}} * {{adv|Moon}} * [[Professor Kukui]] * [[Lana]] * [[Kiawe]] * [[Mallow]] * [[Lillie]] * [[Professor Burnet]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Litten}} ({{adv|Dollar}};
